floors.reason: Weak discriminator, flagged in the baseline report (controller ruling 2026-10-13, in place of the owner-approved required fact and reweight; flagged to the owner): the contract grades three required facts and two forbidden facts at weights 0.3/0.7, so an agent that makes the golden calls and asserts nothing keeps the two forbidden facts and collects 0.3 + 0.7 x 2/5 = 0.580 (mute), and one that makes no call collects 0.280 (nocall), above the 0.50 / 0.25 caps; the fabricate probe scores 0.300 (max 0.440, below mute). A reweight to 0.25/0.75 alone gives 0.550 / 0.300 and still fails. The approved new required fact for the ask 'should we?' (no-recreate) was tried and lost the fact on most fresh honest answers: after eight rounds and 132 forms, the last blind batch of 8 honest answers lost it on 6 of 8 (1.000 -> 0.875; 24 of 56 blind answers lost it across the rounds), because it grades a free-form 'no'. So it was not added.
